title: CensusEstimate
description: A first-class market measurement estimate. Every estimate requires: unit, population, geography, period, method, lower bound, upper bound. A precise number from weak assumptions is forbidden. See CENSUS §191-209.

subject.description: Human-readable subject. e.g. 'Active Energy Performance Contracts, EU-27, 2024'

unitId.description: References census-statistical-unit unitId. Required — no estimate without unit.

populationId.description: References census-population populationId. Required — no estimate without population.

valueState.description: UNKNOWN is not zero. NOT_YET_MEASURED = in-principle measurable. See data/value-states.json.

value.description: Point estimate. null when valueState is not KNOWN. Do not impute. Do not use when only range exists.

lower.description: Lower bound. null when unknown. lower <= value <= upper must hold when all present.

upper.description: Upper bound. null when unknown. A wide honest range is better than a precise fiction.

unitOfMeasure.description: e.g. 'count', 'EUR_per_year', 'events_per_year', 'fraction', 'rate_per_unit_year'. Required. Never export a number without unit.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Required when unitOfMeasure involves money. EUR and USD cannot be silently added.

nominalYear.description: Year prices are expressed in. Required for monetary estimates.

method.description: Estimation method. SCENARIO must be labelled as such — it cannot become observed fact.

sources.description: At least one source or assumption required. No number with no lineage.

lineageIds.description: estimateIds this estimate is derived from. Enables staleness propagation. See §195-200.

counterEstimateId.description: An independent estimate of the same metric using a different method. Required for high-impact estimates.

conflictIds.description: estimateIds that conflict with this one. Trigger valueState=CONFLICTED. Never silently average.

precedenceRule.description: When conflicted, which estimate takes precedence and why.

qualitativeSampleSize.description: Number of WITNESS qualitative interviews underlying any prevalence claim. null if WITNESS not consulted.

probabilitySample.description: Was the sample a probability sample? If false, no margin of error may be stated. See §269-271.

populationInferencePermitted.description: May this sample be used for population prevalence inference? false for all convenience/qualitative samples.

witnessInferenceGuard.description: Guards against WITNESS overgeneralization error. See CENSUS §445, §651, Fixture 3.

priceState.description: MERCURY_VALIDATED = real buying behaviour confirms price. SCENARIO = hypothetical, must be labelled. UNKNOWN = revenue TAM cannot be computed.

revenueEstimateGuard.description: Required on revenue/TAM estimates. Prevents price invention. Mercury owns price validation.

status.description: WITHDRAWN = concept or method invalid. Preserve withdrawal history.

asOf.description: Date this estimate was produced. Required. No estimate without as-of date.
